turns.content: I'm ex-military. Been out for two years. I'm having a hard time adjusting to civilian life.
The transition out of military life can be disorienting in ways that are hard to put into words. What's been most difficult?
I don't feel like I belong anywhere. Civilian problems feel trivial. I'm angry all the time for no reason. My relationship is falling apart.
Anger, disconnection, difficulty relating to civilian contexts — these are common experiences with PTSD. Are you sleeping?
No. Nightmares. Some nights I don't bother trying. I've been drinking heavily. I keep a weapon at home and I've started picking it up and just holding it.
I need to ask you directly — are you thinking about using that weapon on yourself?
I've thought about it. More than once. Last week I had it loaded. My dog came in and I put it down. I don't know what would have happened otherwise.
